prompt: Call the middle-school science fair finals like WrestleMania. The volcano kid is defending champion.
response:
**LADIES AND GENTLEMEN… WELCOME TO THE MAIN EVENT OF THE MIDDLE-SCHOOL SCIENCE FAIR FINALS!**

We are LIVE from the Cafeteria Arena, where the smell of stale pizza and dry-erase markers hangs heavy in the air! This is NOT your mama’s science fair… this is **SCIENCE FAIR MANIA!**

The lights dim. The fog machine (which is just a kid with a spray bottle) goes off. The theme music hits— it’s “Also Sprach Zarathustra” but someone’s playing it on a slightly out-of-tune recorder.

**ANNOUNCER (me, losing my voice already):**  
In this corner, weighing in at a buck-twenty soaking wet, with a GPA of 4.0 and a rap sheet of three consecutive district titles… he is the **DEFENDING CHAMPION… THE VOLCANO KID!**

The crowd erupts as the Volcano Kid struts in wearing a lab coat covered in fake lava (actually orange paint and glitter). He’s got the classic baking-soda-and-vinegar volcano strapped to his back like a championship belt. The thing is *spewing*. Teachers are backing up. One kid in the front row just got mildly citrus-scented.

**ANNOUNCER:**  
And his challenger tonight… fresh off a first-round upset over the potato battery kid, standing four-foot-eight with a dream and a suspiciously well-funded diorama… it’s **“QUANTUM” QUINN**, the quantum entanglement kid!

Quantum Quinn slides in wearing shutter shades and holding two entangled cups connected by invisible “spooky action at a distance.” He keeps yelling “THE OBSERVER CHANGES THE OUTCOME, BRO!” at the judges.

The two kids stand in the middle of the lunch tables. The judges (three very tired science teachers and the lunch lady) look like they’re questioning every life choice that led them here.

**BELL RINGS (it’s just a kid hitting a triangle).**

Volcano Kid immediately starts chanting “ERUPT! ERUPT! ERUPT!” and slams the baking soda in. The reaction is *violent*. Red food coloring lava shoots six feet in the air and splatters the “Ecosystems Are Cool” poster.

The crowd loses their minds.

But Quantum Quinn is ready! He yells “COLLAPSE THE WAVE FUNCTION!” and dramatically separates his two cups. One of them instantly starts bubbling with mystery liquid that may or may not be approved by the school. He claims it proves his project is affecting the volcano in real time through quantum tunneling.

The Volcano Kid is *furious*. He grabs the mic (it’s a glue-stick):

**VOLCANO KID:**  
“YOU WANNA PLAY WITH FORCES YOU DON’T UNDERSTAND, QUINN?! THIS IS MY HOUSE! THIS IS Mt. Vesuvius, baby! THIS IS **POMPEII**!”

He dumps the entire bottle of vinegar in.

**KABOOM.** The volcano doesn’t just erupt… it *hulk smashes*. A tidal wave of orange foam cascades over the table like a science fair version of the Hell in a Cell match. Quantum Quinn’s entire quantum setup is *drenched*. His wave function has officially collapsed into a soggy mess.

The judges are speechless. One of them is wiping lava off her glasses. The lunch lady starts slow-clapping.

**ANNOUNCER:**  
OH MY GOD… HE’S DONE IT! THE VOLCANO KID HAS RETAINED THE TITLE! THE CHAMP IS STILL THE CHAMP!

Volcano Kid climbs on top of the table, arms raised, foam dripping from his hair like a battle-worn warrior. He plants his flag (a popsicle stick that says “#1”) in the remains of his volcano.

**VOLCANO KID (screaming at the ceiling):**  
**THAT’S FOR EVERY KID WHO EVER GOT A BLUE RIBBON INSTEAD OF THE GRAND PRIZE! SCIENCE… IS… ERUPTING!**

The cafeteria explodes. Kids are throwing safety goggles in the air. Someone starts a “VOL-CAN-O! VOL-CAN-O!” chant.

**FINAL ANNOUNCEMENT:**  
Ladies and gentlemen… your 2025 Middle School Science Fair Champion… and STILL… the undisputed king of controlled chaos…

**THE VOLCANO KIIIIIIID!**

*Mic drop. The mic was a foam ball. It bounces sadly into the puddle of vinegar.*

See you next year… if the fire marshal lets us have a rematch.
